description: C2: the toll-keeper's warning post where the old road leaves the King's Road and the keep comes into sight - shown once as the giant passes it, never after the warden has fallen.
text: The old toll-keep above the road, and in the breach of its wall a giant who wears the walls: the Broken Warden. He sleeps standing - walk into his yard or strike him and he wakes. Blows on his wall-shield do little; old Hode by the fire knows how he is beaten.
